2608.23562.title: Physics-Constrained Deep Learning Model for Contactless Blood Pressure Monitoring from Triaxial Bodyseismography
2608.23562.paper_summary: Ballistocardiography (BCG) is promising for unobtrusive long-term blood pressure (BP) monitoring in laboratory settings, but traditional BCG signals are vulnerable to the variations in body-bed interaction with shifted fiducial points in temporal or amplitude axis, and BP varies with personal hemodynamic changes, causing misaligned representations that affect model generalizability and robustness. In this work, we propose a non-invasive BP estimation framework, Phy-BP, based on triaxial bodyseismography (BSG) as an extension of BCG. Firstly, an adaptive quality-control algorithm is designed to select BSG segments enriched with cardiogenic components by jointly considering neighboring beat patterns and universal cardiogenic templates. Furthermore, a physical model is established to describe 3D wave propagation in the body-bed system and is subsequently embedded into the deep learning model to characterize the intrinsic coupling among triaxial BSG signals driven by a single cardiogenic excitation. Thus, multi-axis features are aligned during model training, improving robustness against distortions in real scenarios. Experiments on a 162-hour hospital dataset collected from 21 subjects reveal that the proposed Phy-BP can dynamically filter out low-quality measurements, and the deep learning model training is constrained by physical consistency across different axes to provide faithful BP monitoring, especially when training samples are limited.
2608.23562.paper_summary_zh: 球體心電圖 (BCG) 在實驗室環境中對於不干擾的長期血壓 (BP) 監測具有潛力，但傳統的 BCG 信號容易受到身體與床墊互動的變化影響，這些變化會導致時間或幅度軸上的基準點移位，而 BP 隨著個人的血流動力學變化而變化，造成不對齊的表現，影響模型的普遍性和穩健性。在本研究中，我們提出了一個基於三軸身體地震圖 (BSG) 的非侵入性 BP 估計框架 Phy-BP，作為 BCG 的延伸。首先，設計了一個自適應質量控制算法，通過共同考慮鄰近的心跳模式和通用的心源模板來選擇富含心源成分的 BSG 段。進一步地，建立了一個物理模型來描述身體與床墊系統中的三維波傳播，並隨後將其嵌入深度學習模型中，以表徵由單一心源激發驅動的三軸 BSG 信號之間的內在耦合。因此，在模型訓練期間，多軸特徵得以對齊，提高了對實際情況中扭曲的穩健性。在從 21 名受試者收集的 162 小時醫院數據集上的實驗顯示，所提出的 Phy-BP 能夠動態過濾低質量測量，並且深度學習模型的訓練受到不同軸之間物理一致性的限制，以提供真實的 BP 監測，特別是在訓練樣本有限的情況下。
